_meta.game: The Old King's Crown (Eerie Idol Games, 2025) -> browser game 'The Thornbound Throne'
_meta.base_game_only: Wild Kingdom expansion (Aeronauts, Legendary Creatures, Whispering Tower tile, Boon tokens, +15 Kingdom cards) deliberately not documented
_meta.name_policy: ALL names/text here are NEW original wording; original titles/flavour/card text are NOT included. Original-name mapping lives only in the private scratch dir (not in repo).

timings.spring_action: sprout icon; in-turn-order optional, once per round per player
timings.day_action: sun icon; Summer, per Clash, only if source card is Active in the current Clash (cards)
timings.night_effect: moon icon; Summer, per Clash, mandatory, simultaneous
timings.winter_effect: snowflake icon; Winter Effects Step, mandatory
timings.passive: always on while card/tile is in play (in Supply, on Player Board, Active, etc.)
timings.on_acquire: bold text on the printed card: resolve when acquired

dsl.ops_note: effect_spec.ops are informal machine-oriented verbs (strings) for the implementer; they paraphrase the effect, they are not a formal grammar. inf=Influence, lore=Lore, str=Strength.

traits.invulnerable: immune to Elimination (printed as shield icon; ASSUMPTION high)
traits.resilient: Eliminated goes to owner's Discard not Lost Pile (helmet icon; ASSUMPTION high)
traits.pathfinder: used to Journey -> goes to Discard not Lost Pile (map icon; confirmed by Kingdom card 'all your cards gain pathfinder' + rulebook example)

dsl.icon_assumptions: Archetype glyph letters in the rulebook text were cross-matched with rulebook examples (jester=ruse, flask=trader, people=follower, hood=agent, horse=cavalry, rocket=war machine, chalice=captain, fist=champion, crown=heir). Votes = gavel icon bottom-left of card, Lore = scroll/quill icon bottom-right (confirmed by card effect texts that use the same glyphs).

map.adjacency: NONE - the map has no adjacency or movement graph. Three horizontal Regions (rows), two Locations each. Heralds are placed on any Location; Supporters on any Region; cards next to any Region. Only 'Flank' etc. move things between Regions, and any unresolved Region is a legal target.
map.hq_note: Order of Regions is only a layout; resolution order is set each Summer by the last-place player via Clash markers I/II/III.

councils.benefit: When you claim your Herald Reward you may remove any number of your cards/markers here; gain influence equal to total Votes removed (extra to the Herald Reward's own gain). Cards go to Discard; markers to Supply. A card/marker worth 2+ votes must be removed whole.

Action (Autumn): place Faction Markers from Supply equal to your Votes here onto Locations of your choice (any split). Any Location with 4+ of your markers: remove them all and resolve that Location's Reward ignoring its influence value (Location text only, no Herald Reward). Markers persist round to round. Need >=1 vote to use.
Action (Autumn): move Supporters from Map and/or Lost Pile to your Player Board equal to your Votes here; +1 extra if you have strictly the most Votes here (need >=1 vote).
